# Setup
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", error = TRUE)

library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(conflicted)

conflicts_prefer(purrr::map())
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter())

basedir <- here("orthofinder/2026-08-07")
```

# Data

```{r}
sptr <- read.tree(here(
  basedir,
  "results/out/Species_Tree/SpeciesTree_rooted_node_labels.txt"
))

genetrees <- read_rds(here(basedir, "results/processed/genetrees.rds"))
dup_nodes <- read_rds(here(basedir, "results/processed/duplication-nodes.rds"))
sym_og <- read_rds(here(basedir, "results/processed/symbol-og-mapping.rds"))
hogs <- read_rds(here(basedir, "results/processed/hogs.rds"))
hog_nodes <- read_rds(here(basedir, "results/processed/hog-node-ids.rds"))
```

# functions

```{r}
nodelabel_to_nodeid <- function(tr, labels) {
  which(tr$node.label %in% labels) + length(tr$tip.label)
}

get_mrca_node_id <- function(.sp1, .sp2) {
  all_labels <- c(sptr$tip.label, sptr$node.label)
  nodeid <- getMRCA(sptr, c(.sp1, .sp2))
  all_labels[nodeid]
}

get_hog_nodes <- function(.og, .sptr_node) {
  hog_nodes |>
    filter(og == .og, node == .sptr_node) |>
    pull(genetree_nodeid) |>
    unique()
}

plot_gene_tree <- function(
  .symbol = NULL,
  .og = NULL,
  label_dup_nodes = TRUE,
  label_hog_nodes = TRUE,
  node_for_hog = NULL
) {
  if (!is.null(.symbol) & !is.null(.og)) {
    stop("Provide either .symbol or .og, not both")
  }
  if (is.null(.symbol) & !is.null(.og)) {
    og <- .og
  }
  if (!is.null(.symbol) & is.null(.og)) {
    og <- sym_og[[.symbol]]
  }

  x <- genetrees[[og]]

  par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
  plot.phylo(
    x,
    label.offset = 0.01,
    align.tip.label = TRUE,
    x.lim = max(node.depth.edgelength(x)) * 1.3
  )

  if (label_dup_nodes) {
    nodelabels(node = dup_nodes[[og]], col = "grey", pch = 19, cex = 1.5)
  }

  if (label_hog_nodes) {
    x_hogs <- get_hog_nodes(og, node_for_hog)
    nodelabels(node = x_hogs, col = "salmon", pch = 19, cex = 1.5)
  }
}
```

# Species tree for reference

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5

plot.phylo(sptr, show.node.label = TRUE, use.edge.length = FALSE)
```

# HOG node issue

I think there is an issue with what `Orthofinder` calls the hierarchical orthogroup (HOG) node in a gene tree in one particular situation. 

The follwing is a situation where it works as expected and correctly. Let's try to find the HOG node at the level of tunicates, which descend from the node `N3` in the species tree above and contain two species in out sample, _Ciona robusta_ (crob) and _Styela clava_ (scla), for the orthogroup containing the mouse gene _Slc5a1_. There were two paralogs of this gene in the common ancestor of _crob_ and _scla_, as correctly identified by the two HOG nodes in the gene tree by `Orthofinder`. 

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

slc_og <- sym_og[["Slc5a1"]]
slc_tr <- genetrees[[slc_og]]

plot_gene_tree(
  "Slc5a1",
  label_dup_nodes = FALSE,
  label_hog_nodes = TRUE,
  node_for_hog = "N3"
)
```


The following is an example where the HOG node identified by `Orthofinder` is unexpected / incorrect. Here, we find the HOG node at the tunicate level again for the gene tree of the orthogroup containing the mouse gene _Abcg1_. In this case, in the common ancestor of _crob_ and _scla_ there was only one cooy of this gene, and the HOG node at the tunicate level in this gene tree should be (at least according to me) the node `n2`, whereas that identified by `Orthofinder` is node `n0`, which is the base of the entire orthogroup. 

```{r}
abcg_og <- sym_og[["Abcg1"]]
abcg_tr <- genetrees[[abcg_og]]

hog_nodes |>
  filter(og == abcg_og, node == "N3")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

par(mar = c(1, 5, 1, 1), xpd = TRUE)
plot.phylo(
  abcg_tr,
  show.node.label = TRUE,
  align.tip.label = TRUE,
  x.lim = max(node.depth.edgelength(abcg_tr)) * 1.3
)
nodelabels(
  text = "Tunicate HOG\n(should be)",
  node = nodelabel_to_nodeid(abcg_tr, "n2"),
  frame = "none",
  offset = 1,
  adj = c(1.1, 0.5),
  col = "blue"
)
nodelabels(
  text = "Tunicate HOG\n(Orthofinder)",
  node = hog_nodes$genetree_nodeid[which(
    hog_nodes$og == abcg_og & hog_nodes$node == "N3"
  )],
  frame = "none",
  adj = c(1.1, 0.5),
  col = "red"
)
```

For the purpose of correctly identifying orthologs and their types (1:1, 1:n, 1:1, and n:n), this does's make a difference. As seen below, the listed HOG for this gene tree at tunicate level (`N3` node in species tree) only contains the _crob_ and _scla_ genes, as expected and correctly. 

```{r}
hogs |>
  filter(og == abcg_og, node == "N3") |>
  glimpse()
```

This still feels like a problem to me that should be fixed.
